integrity: No empirical finite run is used to justify the infinite generality; the proof is by structural induction and combinatorial counting.
scientific_limitations: All finite n are covered deductively, for nonreflexive rooted stars only. Repeated or missing successor types are intentionally identified in the logical quotient. Related bisimulation ideas are longstanding. No independent review or absolute priority guarantee.
title: Exact pointed-theory spectrum and optimal tests for non-contingency stars
